name: EarthQuaker Devices
dirt_evidence: Hoof; Tone Reaper; Dirt Transmitter; Chrysalis; Monarch; Hoof Reaper
notes: Founded 2004 by Jamie Stillman. Official history says Hoof was first full-production run in 2007; early devices were built in the Akron basement. Do not collapse early basement production with later factory-era revisions.

name: Death By Audio
dirt_evidence: Total Sonic Annihilation; Fuzz War; Interstellar Overdriver; Apocalypse
notes: Founded 2002 by Oliver Ackermann. Company began as web-based effects customization and evolved into a pedal manufacturer; retain custom-build origin separately from later standard retail catalog.

name: Malekko Heavy Industry
notes: Started September 2006 in Austin by Joshua Holley and Paul Barker; moved to Portland in 2010. B:Assmaster is anchored to February 2007 specialist publication and 2007 contemporary review. Preserve synth/module and pedal activities as related but distinct catalog layers.

name: Caroline Guitar Company
dirt_evidence: Wave Cannon; Olympia Fuzz; Icarus boost boundary
notes: Caroline says it launched in 2010. Wave Cannon first sales were October 2010; Effects Database publication date is November 8, 2010. First 75 were hand-built and numbered. Olympia Fuzz followed in 2011.

name: Walrus Audio
notes: USPTO-derived trademark record gives first use in commerce as Nov. 21, 2009; later builder interview says Brady Smith got Walrus operating in 2011. Preserve trademark first-use, company formation, and first-product dates as separate evidence fields.

name: Black Arts Toneworks
notes: BAT says it has been building pedals since 2010. Archived December 2010 posts document Pharaoh production runs. Founder history describes the Pharaoh as beginning from a modified Russian Big Muff made for personal use before others requested units.

name: Dr. Scientist Sounds
notes: Early Effects Database entries are dated August 18, 2006, including The Elements family. Current official page confirms The Elements as a dual-channel overdrive/distortion. Full historical dirt catalog still requires separate enumeration.
